summary: Verified ADAM Protocol easter-egg after mute-fix + ElevenLabs voice + mobile 11-tap. Backend: GET /api/adam/voice/status returns {enabled:true}; POST /api/adam/voice with {text:'Hello.'} returns 200 with audio data URL prefixed 'data:audio/mpeg;base64,' (verified via curl). Frontend (Playwright): (1) Konami sequence opens overlay [data-testid=adam-protocol]. (2) Mute button flips aria-label between 'Mute ADAM Protocol' <-> 'Unmute ADAM Protocol' and persists localStorage 'adcom_adam_muted' between '0' and '1'. (3) ESC removes overlay. (4) After reload + Konami reactivate, previously persisted muted=1 respected (aria-label 'Unmute ADAM Protocol') and localStorage unchanged by activate. (5) 10 taps on footer copyright does NOT open ADAM; 11th tap opens it. No console/page errors during any flow.
critical_code_review_comments: adamAudio.setMuted now cancels Web Speech and pauses currentAudio (ElevenLabs <audio>) — fix is correct and covers the reported bug.

adamAudio.say() sets this.currentAudio without clearing it on natural end (onended -> finish only resolves), so a stale reference persists until next say(). Not a functional bug but worth clearing on onended for cleanliness.

AdamProtocol.jsx local `muted` state is initialised from adamAudio.isMuted() and only updated via toggleMute; if setMuted is called elsewhere (e.g. programmatic) UI won't sync. Currently only user path uses toggle so fine.
Footer 11-tap uses a rolling 3s window (setTimeout resets counter on inactivity) — 11 rapid taps opens ADAM as intended.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ADAM overlay uses timeout-driven phase transitions (boot -> dashboard @ ~onBootDone, dashboard -> narrative @6.5s). For mute-toggle checks only the boot phase is needed and the mute button renders immediately with the overlay. Use page.keyboard.press per key for Konami; 'b' and 'a' are lowercase. localStorage key 'adcom_adam_muted' = '1' when muted else '0'.
